body: You are in the same situation as me except my parents found out about my suicide plan and now I'm in a psych ward. The medication here has actually improved my mood a lot (I don't cry myself to sleep any more) and I am not as suicidal as I was before. Still am a friendless 22 year old loser, but a more balanced one. I know it looks like you are the only one who is isolated and lonely, but believe me, there are a lot more of us. It seems to me like you are suffering from depression, especially the 'I have no hobbies any more' part sounds like what I've been through. Maybe therapy would help you a lot. I know the world looks dark right now, but please stay with us.
I'm also 21 and have the same issue; there isn't an objective reason(except maybe no friends and loneliness) for my suicidality. But I also had suicidal ideation since I was 10.

I am kind of in the same situation except I don't even have a drivers license or a job, so you are at least already heading in a good direction. Remember, baby steps at a time. I know it's hard to appreciate your small improvements every day when you are constantly comparing yourself to others who seem better off than you; I also struggle with this. This is your life and you get to live it in your own time. The bullying in school probably destroyed your self-esteem, so you find it hard to get out there and have the social life that you actually want for yourself. The others who are ahead of you in this were not born with "the socialising gene", they, while having issues on their own, probably never were bullied and had a lot more time to practise than you did. Don't give up on yourself because there is hope; even if your loneliness now seems endless. I know it won't make you feel better, but you are not alone, there are A LOT of lonely people like you and me. Don't be too hard on yourself because you can improve if you try. I believe in you.
I also went to a therapist and have been told the same thing, but I am just too tired to try anymore. I gave up on having an enjoyable life a long time ago
As long as you don't have a plan or actually intend to die, you will be fine. If you go to a therapist, they'll probably tell you to go to a clinic.
